ValidationRule.description: When a Deal is in an Approval Process, the Mapped Opportunity can not be changed by non Admins.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(or_Create_Opportunity_upon_Approval__c), TEXT(or_Opp_Reg_Approval_Flow_Status__c) = 'Approvals in progress', $Profile.Name != 'Tanium Partner Portal Admin', NOT($Permission.Deal_Registration_Manager), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Create Opportunity Upon Approval field cannot be changed when the current Deal is in the approval process.
